title: One step for a straight instruction
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a program, $pos$ a program counter, $m$ a memory, and $i$ an instruction. If the program at $pos$ begins with $i$ and $i$ is a straight instruction (one, addition, subtraction, multiplication, load, or store), then one step from $(pos,m)$ reaches program counter $pos+1$ with memory equal to the effect of $i$ on $m$.
hypotheses_covered: The program at pos begins with i
